text: Protocol versioning, clients: send the header, handle 426 by updating

Landed in 7eb2cb4 (web), af18e35 (Android), 2ea0288 (my follow-up: concurrent in-flight 426s no longer flash the notice while the reload is under way; reload modelled in tests by resetting module state). Web: header on every apiFetch, one sessionStorage-guarded reload then a full-page notice, App swaps routes for the notice. Android: ProtocolInterceptor first in chain, ErrorInterceptor raises ProtocolState (no logout, no quarantine), SyncEngine/SyncWorker stop without touching the queue, UpdateChecker.checkForced ignores switch and interval, blocking UpdateRequiredScreen reusing the download intent. Protocol-equality web test now asserts against server protocol.py on main. 15 mutations caught by the agent.
